messages:
Sandra: Quick kickoff thread for the joint HW perf/W + throughput project. Primary deliverables: public-friendly headline numbers + partner appendix with kernel diffs and raw CSVs.
Kevin: Agreed. Metrics we must capture: tokens/sec, watts (board+host), tokens/joule, latency p50/p95, and a brief PCIe/bandwidth summary.
Matt: Bench matrix proposal: models=[Llama-2-13B, Falcon-40B], quant=[fp16,int8], seq=[2k,8k,16k], batch=[1,8,32]. Include cold (no kv) vs warm (prefill 50 steps). Add app-sim chat run (5-min replay).
NVIDIA Eng: We'll run H100S + A800. Recommend NV driver 535.86+, CUDA 12.2. We'll supply a kernel-params text and small fused-kernel patch. NVML sampling at 250ms gives good power curves.
Intel Eng: We'll provide Gaudi reference numbers and a small perf patch for fused ops on our side. We'll also include RAPL guidance for host-side power.
Anya: Marketing asks for a short, conservative headline like: "X tokens/sec at Y W on H100S" and a methodology link. Legal needs partner signoff and 10 business days for co-brand review.
Sandra: Proposed timeline: Day 0-3 infra + AMI build, Day 4-7 kernel tuning + partner patch review, Day 8-10 runs + CSV collection, Day 11-14 validation + write-up. Can partners review kernel diffs within 48h?
NVIDIA Eng: Yes, we'll review within 48h after receiving the PR. Please include a reproducible AMI/container and exact env vars.
Kevin: Minimal run snippet we use (adapt as needed):
```bash
MODEL=$1; SEQ=$2; BATCH=$3; QUANT=$4
./redwood_bench --model $MODEL --seq $SEQ --batch $BATCH --quant $QUANT \n  --warmup 50 --steps 600 --measure-power --power-sample-ms 250 \n  --output-run run_${MODEL}_${SEQ}_${BATCH}_${QUANT}.csv
```
Matt: We'll wrap that to capture TSC-based latency, NVML samples, and a simple parser to compute tokens/sec and tokens/J. PR with scripts + README by tomorrow.
NVIDIA Eng: For kernel tuning try: nr_hugepages=1024, iommu=pt, irqbalance=off, and enable our movdqa micro-op fix in fused kernel. We'll test delta and attach per-step CSVs.
Intel Eng: For our runs set hugepages=512, swapoff, and we'll provide micro-op reordering patch. We'll also attach host power CSV from RAPL.
Anya: Who owns the AWS marketplace coordination and co-branding assets? Need a single point to start legal.
AWS BD: I'll own marketplace + legal outreach. Request: final numbers 10 business days prior to publish. Keep claims conservative and cite methodology.
Benchmark Bot: Job queued: joint-hw-bench-1755101111 on perf-pool-4, est runtime 7h. Status: queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sandra: Actions: @NVIDIA Eng & @Intel Eng -> kernel diffs + testing notes; @Kevin -> AMI + infra today; @Matt -> bench scripts + parser; @AWS BD -> legal kickoff; @Anya -> blog skeleton + asset checklist. Sync Thurs 9am PT.
Matt: Adding an e2e app-sim (chat load) at batch sizes 8 and 32 as requested. Will include jitter plots.
Kevin: I'll wire IPMI and attach an external meter on a sample host for cross-check. We'll publish both NVML-only and external-meter-adjusted tokens/J so readers can compare.
NVIDIA Eng: One more ask: include raw per-step CSVs and a short appendix showing how to reproduce the perf/W numbers from CSVs. We can sign off faster if there's full transparency.
Sandra: Perfect. We'll keep the public blog summary short and link to the partner appendix with raw data, kernel diffs, and reproduction steps. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
